notes: v4.3 issue-pool task (starship/starship#6861). The agent gets the REAL starship prompt-engine tree (Rust, edition-2024 source style) at the parent commit, sees only the user-visible symptom (the `starship explain` breakdown table misaligns whenever a module value embeds ANSI color escape sequences: the column padding is computed from a width measurement that counts each byte of an ESC[..m sequence as printable), and must itself write a failing reproduction (a self-contained inline unit test named repro_ansi_width_* in the same source file as the measurement logic) before localising the bug in src/print.rs and fixing it, without being told the file, function, issue number or commit (the fix commit is not reachable from the clone and there is no network). The verifier plants the project's OWN regression test (the pre-existing inline unit test test_grapheme_aware_width as the fix commit extends it with the magenta-string assertion, extracted at image build time into /opt/golden, never vendored into this task tree; sha256-pinned) plus three authored hidden test functions (bold/reset codes around plain text; interleaved multi-color codes; 256-color 38;5;N parameter sequences) and the agent-reproduction test, recompiles the crate offline at 1 vCPU, runs the freshly built test binary DIRECTLY with the 'width' filter so every width-related unit test must pass, and demands explicit ' ... ok' lines for every required test. Provenance is enforced at the blob level (every tracked file except src/print.rs must hash to the pinned commit's blob; no untracked non-ignored files; object store holds only the pinned commit) so a scratch file, a reformat commit, or a sabotaged test file all fail. The over-fix direction is guarded: a fix that strips ALL non-printing data or changes plain-text widths breaks the pre-existing width tests (test_grapheme_aware_width with the 11-column plain text and pipestatus_width); a fix that only special-cases the golden input fails the hidden cases; a fix that pads the explain table by other means but leaves the measurement wrong fails the golden test and the agent-repro check on the pristine tree. Nop container scores 0 fast (no source change and no summary.md). Agent measures the real incremental rebuild at 1 vCPU (tens of seconds) inside a 2400s budget with the binary and test harness prebuilt in the image.
